subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct for antacids?

options.text: Antacids are useful to neutralise excess stomach acid.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Antacids are strong acids**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Antacids

 
• It is a substance used to neutralize excess Hydrochloric acid produced in the stomach.
 
• The action of antacid is a neutralization reaction- Acid + Base → Salt + Water 
 
• Antacids are a class of medicines that neutralize the acid in the stomach.
 
• Some amount of HCl is needed for digestion but excess amount formed due to indigestion creates problems.
 
• The antacid can only give temporary relief to the symptoms. 
 
• They contain ingredients such as aluminum, calcium, magnesium, or sodium bicarbonate which act as bases (alkalis) to counteract stomach acid and make its pH more neutral.
 
• We consume antacids when we get Acidity that is when we have a Gastric response to overeating and such as more HCl starts forming in the stomach.
 
• Antacids are used which are mild bases that react to Acids in the stomach to form Harmless salts and thus stopping the HCl from damaging all the inner linings.
 
• It will balance the pH of the stomach otherwise excess amounts of HCl produced will burn the stomach wall.
 
• Mg(OH)2 and NaHCO3 is an antacid.
 
• Therefore Antacids are not strong acid.
